Welcome to Star Wars: Echoes of War!

Fire and foremost, a massive thank you to Zunath for making the original Star Wars: Legends of the Old Republic an Open Source Project. Community Collaboration is what keeps NWN alive.

If you're new to how the systems on this server differ to regular NNW, please visit the wiki at https://wiki.starwars.com/

We take no credit for this website, it is maintained entirely by the original SWLOR team. We mention it here because mechanically, our server runs the same systems as the SWLOR server. The differences between SWLOR and this server are at present purely narrative and design philosophy focused, with more specific details located in our Discord. We have already changed some areas to fit our lore, and this is an evolving process, so you should expect changes to continue into the future. Please also note that we're a very small team that primarily just loves Star Wars and loves RP, and so our dev cycle is bound to be far less structured then that of the original server. We're here to have fun and tell good stories, so if you are too, you'll fit right in!

Here are a few quick things you should know:

1. Press 'C' to open your character sheet to access important options.

2. You can purchase some starting items from the vendor in the Northern part of this area.

3. You can customize your character appearance from the 'Appearance' button on your character sheet.

4. /help will print out a useful list of commands in your combat log.

5. We log ALL chat messages, including tells, to our database for auditing purposes. By continuing to play here you agree to allow your conversations to be stored.

6. Until you name another player, you see their grey Public Description.

Type /name <label>, then click another player, to save a private name or nickname that only you can see. Example: /name Mira

To set your own grey Public Description,  type /name <description>, then click on yourself. Example: /name A Weathered Human

Type /introduce <name> to offer a name or alias to visible players within 20m. Example: /introduce Mira

Use /introductions to review offered names and choose Remember or Dismiss. An introduction saves no name until the recipient chooses Remember.

If you need further help, don't hesitate to ask in Discord.

May the Force be with you!
